# ClickSurvivor Hub

> A multi-game web platform for free incremental, idle, and clicker games. Play directly in your browser — no download required.

## Games

### Seoul Survival (서울 생존기 : 흙수저 탈출)

- **URL**: https://clicksurvivor.com/seoulsurvival/
- **Genre**: Incremental, Idle, Clicker, Economy Simulation
- **Languages**: Korean, English

Seoul Survival is a prestige-based incremental idle game set in modern Seoul. Start as a minimum-wage worker, click to earn wages, invest in financial products (savings, stocks, crypto), buy real estate (from studio apartments to skyscrapers), and prestige by purchasing the legendary Tower for ₩1 trillion. Each prestige cycle earns Career Points (CP) that permanently boost your income in the next run.

**Core Mechanics:**
- Click labor with a promotion system (part-timer → CEO)
- Financial investments: savings accounts, stocks, cryptocurrency
- Real estate: villas, apartments, officetels, buildings, towers
- Prestige system: reset progress for permanent multipliers
- Synergy bonuses between investment categories
- Market events that affect prices and income
- Achievements and global leaderboards
- Cloud save via Google sign-in

### Kimchi Invasion (The Red Planet Protocol)

- **URL**: https://clicksurvivor.com/kimchi-invasion/
- **Genre**: Factory Automation, Idle, Simulation, Sci-Fi
- **Languages**: Korean, English

Kimchi Invasion is a sci-fi factory automation game. Grow kimchi on Mars and export it to Earth. Manage production lines, optimize logistics, and scale your interplanetary kimchi empire.

## Key Features

- **100% Free**: No ads, no in-app purchases, no paywalls
- **Browser-Based**: Instant play — no download or installation needed
- **PWA Support**: Install as an app on mobile and desktop
- **Cloud Save**: Save your progress with Google sign-in
- **Multilingual**: Full Korean and English support
- **Offline Progress**: Earn income even while away
